LanguageData.LP_PactScroll.label: pact scroll
LanguageData.LP_PactScroll.description: A pact written on unknown leather, sealed with wax bearing the crest of some otherworldly patron. Only after 4 hours of reading at a pact lectern can you see what it says: three selectable boons, the visible cost, the payment cycle, and the hidden clauses tucked between the lines. Cannot be crafted.
LanguageData.LP_EntanglingRope.label: binding rope
LanguageData.LP_EntanglingRope.description: A golden rope erinyes use to bind people; it flies out and wraps the target on its own. Hung at the waist (trinket slot): ability "Binding rope": one target within 8 cells makes a Dexterity save (difficulty rises with the user's proficiency bonus and Dexterity; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success), and on failure is bound for 4 seconds. 10 uses of durability, then it breaks. Cooldown 2 hours.
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntHorn.label: wild hunt horn
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntHorn.description: The curved horn of a wild hunt rider, sounding like wolves howling in the wind. Single use: after blowing it, for 2 hours the colony's canines on the map (dogs, wolves, worgs, blink dogs...) get move speed +30% and melee damage +20%; hostile humanlikes each have a 10% chance to flee in fear.
LanguageData.LP_PactLectern.label: pact lectern
LanguageData.LP_PactLectern.description: A chained bookstand lectern: one end of the chain is fastened to the reading stand, the other locks the compartment where pacts are kept. Pact scrolls can only be read here: read for 4 hours to see the terms, then review, negotiate, sign or refuse. The lectern can also "compensate the patron" (pay off debt) and tear up a pact using the true name scroll of the patron's agent; the inspect pane lists all the colony's pacts.
LanguageData.LP_InfernalForge.label: infernal forge
LanguageData.LP_InfernalForge.description: Dispater's iron city forge: soul coins burn in its black iron hearth, with green flames. Can do every rune anvil recipe at ×1.5 work speed. Burns soul coins, consumed only while working (1 coin = 1 day). Can't be built: only obtained from Dispater's boon "Infernal forge".
